style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the leather purse is the warm hero object of the tool's purse view: keys in its tan-brown family, Enter a contrasting berry treat, soft butter rub-out, light cream panel (same as Count the Money)

images.object: short chunky yellow hexagonal wooden pencil, flat end left
images.why: the things on the shelf and in the bill lines ('a row of at most nine of one kind of thing', pencils); one skin drawn once per thing
images.prompt: A single short, chunky, new yellow hexagonal wooden pencil lying perfectly straight and horizontal, with a flat plain brass-coloured end at the left and the sharpened pale-wood cone with a dark graphite tip pointing to the right; glossy golden-yellow lacquer and crisp straight edges.

images.object: classic pink and blue rubber eraser with a pale cardboard sleeve
images.why: the things on the shelf and in the bill lines (an eraser at a price); one skin drawn once per thing
images.prompt: A single classic rectangular pink rubber eraser with a smaller blue end, half covered by a plain pale cardboard sleeve, lying flat and viewed from directly above, completely blank with no printing or text.

images.why: the things on the shelf and in the bill lines (a sharpener at a price); one skin drawn once per thing
images.prompt: A small bright-blue moulded plastic pencil sharpener, a short rounded wedge with one round hole and a tiny steel blade held by a small screw, lying flat and viewed from directly above, completely plain with no printing.

images.object: bright blue stitched school exercise notebook with white page edges
images.why: the things on the shelf and in the bill lines, and the 'notebook' of the question 'What does 1 notebook cost?'; one skin drawn once per thing
images.prompt: A closed school exercise notebook seen from directly above, bright blue glossy cover with a plain blank white rectangular name panel near the top, a darker blue cloth binding strip with white stitching down the left edge, a thick stack of white page edges showing along the right side and the bottom, a soft shadow, completely blank with no printing.

images.object: plain opaque yellow plastic school ruler, blank face
images.why: the things on the shelf and in the bill lines (a scale/ruler at a price); the ruler's marks are plain and drawn in code over this blank face
images.prompt: A single flat opaque sunny-yellow plastic school ruler lying perfectly straight and horizontal, with square ends and a slightly bevelled edge, its face completely smooth, blank and empty, with nothing printed or engraved on it.

images.why: the things on the shelf and in the bill lines (a pen, 'A pen set costs'); one skin drawn once per thing
images.prompt: A single plain dark-blue glossy plastic ballpoint pen lying perfectly straight and horizontal, a slim round barrel with a small pocket clip, a short cone tip and a click button at the left end, completely plain with no printing.

images.object: open cardboard box of wax crayons
images.why: the things on the shelf and in the bill lines (a crayon box at a price); one skin drawn once per thing
images.prompt: A flat open rectangular cardboard crayon box in plain bright green, seen from directly above, holding a neat row of wax crayons side by side in assorted bright colours with their blunt cones showing, the box completely plain and blank with no printing.

images.object: empty woven wicker shopping basket with a handle
images.why: the shopping basket that holds the things being bought ('Place the basket on the counter'; all through the tool); drawn once, empty
images.prompt: An empty natural-straw woven wicker shopping basket with one arched wicker handle folded flat to one side, seen from directly above, warm honey-brown woven texture with a neat rim.

images.why: Stage 'the purse of notes and coins on its left pan at x 160, y 300' (phase 4, Is there enough money?); drawn once, the notes and coins stay on it as code and the money photos
images.prompt: A small soft tan-brown leather coin purse, the whole purse in full view with every edge, corner and the rounded bottom visible, a rounded flap with neat darker stitching, a matte grained leather surface and a plain brass clasp, small in the frame with a wide even border of empty white all round it.

images.why: the paper bill of phase 3 ('the bill replaces the shelf ... a table of four columns'); a blank slip behind the code-drawn table
images.prompt: A single blank light buff-yellow paper shop receipt slip, a tall narrow rectangle lying flat and viewed from directly above, with a straight top edge and a neatly torn zigzag bottom edge, the paper completely blank, smooth and empty, with nothing printed on it.

images.why: 'A plain shop counter fills the working area' (the setting that stays the same all through the tool); a backdrop behind the code-drawn shelf, bill and balance
images.prompt: A wide flat desk top of pale cream oak wood with a soft warm fine grain running along its length, very light in tone, evenly lit, clean and completely empty.

images.object: shallow round terracotta-orange clay serving dish
images.why: 'a row of at most six plates, each ... large enough to hold a small pile of flat notes and discs' (phase 2, Sharing money equally); one skin drawn once per plate
images.prompt: A single round shallow matte terracotta-orange glazed clay serving dish with a gently raised rim, seen from directly above, completely empty, smooth and unmarked.
